wholePhysicalScope: The named 11-corner current footprint and native 2020 front and rear photo locations resolve the east-facing stone tower, west end and side ruin.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the barrel roof, square tower and roofless south annex.
limitations: The model reflects the 2020 condition and the permanent features confirmed in 2026, before restoration. Estimated roof, wall and tower heights follow proportions in the exact photos.
